answer: The summit ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own falcon record, and its own share of the delta quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 3403 identities would post 3718 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
